pairs.why: A's moon is a few large quiet craters on a plain sky, while B adds sparkle stars, scattered pebbles and small leg details that the real cards' few-large-shapes environments do not have.
A keeps the real card's tone-on-tone wavy green backdrop and a cluster of small rocks and corals, whereas B has a glowing lime halo and a bare, plain rock base.
B's stripe backdrop is a little more muted, and its floor has fewer, thinner plank lines, closer to the real card's single seam. The gap is small.
B's crown pattern is larger and sparser, closer to the real large soft suitcase motifs, while A's crowns are small and dense.
Both use the same quiet wavy purple field with the rope floating on it, so staging gives no reason to choose.
A's crowns are low contrast and quiet, but B's bigger, brighter crowns and glow halo compete with the booth.
B has fewer small bushes and flowers and one large bush mass, closer to the real card's few large quiet shapes. Both still add a cloudy sky.
Both swap the real card's top-down wood table for the same striped wall backdrop with a plank floor, so they are equally off.
